   inst:"University of Klagenfurt, Austria", role:"Co-supervisor", period:"Current"},

  {cat:"phd-co", name:"Abdalrahman Mahmoud A. M. Ibrahim",
   topic:"The Cognitive Stack: Bridging Topological Perception and Semantic Reasoning for Grounded Embodied Intelligence",
   inst:"University of Klagenfurt, Austria", role:"Co-supervisor", period:"Current"},

  {cat:"phd-co", name:"Eliska Sieglova",
   topic:"The Cognitive Stack: Bridging Topological Perception and Semantic Reasoning for Grounded Embodied Intelligence",
   inst:"Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU)", role:"Co-supervisor", period:"Current"},


  // ── Postdocs ───────────────────────────────────────────
  // ── Visiting Researchers ───────────────────────────────
  {cat:"visiting", name:"Visiting PhD Student — University of Verona",
   topic:"Computer Science / AI research",
   inst:"Hosted at Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU)", role:"Host supervisor", period:"01.03.2025–31.08.2025"},


  {cat:"phd-co", name:"International Co-supervision Network",
   topic:"Co-supervision arrangements with international partners across multiple institutions.",
   inst:"University of Johannesburg (South Africa) · UFRGS Brazil · University of Klagenfurt (Austria) · University of Vienna (Austria) · University of Udine (Italy)", role:"Co-supervisor", period:"Ongoing"},

  // ── Master ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  {cat:"master", name:"Sheikh Hasan Elahi", 
  topic:"Predicting Plant Growth in Controlled Environments via Few-Shot Learning and Representative Sampling",

  {cat:"master", name:"Taofik Muhriz", 
  topic:"Automated Prediction of Mucus Plug Burden in Lung CT Scans",

  {cat:"master", name:"Katarzyna Haland", 
  topic:"Zero-Shot Learning for Wrist-Worn Micro-Activity Recognition: Evaluation, Pipeline Analysis, and Cross-Dataset Generalisation", 
  inst:"Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU)", role:"Main supervisor", period:"2026"},

  {cat:"master", name:"Siyi Hu",

  {cat:"master", name:"Sigrid Knag",
   topic:"Seagrass and Seaweed Detection Approaches Using Remote Sensing and Google Earth Engine",
   inst:"Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU)", role:"Main supervisor", period:"2023"},

  {cat:"master", name:"Ole Gilje Gunnarshaug",
   topic:"ECG-based Human Emotion Recognition Using Generative Models",
   inst:"Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU)", role:"Main supervisor", period:"2023"},
];

const CATS = {
  all:       "All",
  "phd-main":"PhD — Main Supervisor",
  "phd-co":  "PhD — Co-Supervisor",
  "phd-grad":"PhD — Graduated",
  master:    "Master's Students",
  "postdoc":   "Postdocs",
  "visiting":  "Visiting Researchers",
};

const CBADGE = {
  "phd-main":"background:#EEEDFE;color:#3C3489",
  "phd-co":  "background:#e8f1fb;color:#0c447c",
  "phd-grad":"background:#f1efe8;color:#444441",
  master:    "background:#E1F5EE;color:#085041",
  postdoc:  "background:#FAEEDA;color:#633806",
  visiting: "background:#fbeaf0;color:#72243e",
};

let activeCat = "all";

function render() {
  const filtered = STUDENTS.filter(i => activeCat === "all" || i.cat === activeCat);

  const filters = Object.entries(CATS).map(([k,v]) => {
    const on = activeCat === k;
    const style = on
      ? "background:#1a3a5c;color:white;border-color:#1a3a5c;"
      : "background:white;color:#6c757d;border-color:#dde4ed;";
    const count = k === "all" ? STUDENTS.length : STUDENTS.filter(i=>i.cat===k).length;
    return `<span onclick="setCat('${k}')" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid;cursor:pointer;${style}">${v} <span style="opacity:0.7">(${count})</span></span>`;
  }).join("");

  const items = filtered.map(i => {
    const badge = `<span style="font-size:9px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:600;margin-right:6px;${CBADGE[i.cat]}">${CATS[i.cat]}</span>`;
    return `<div style="padding:0.85rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f4;">
      <div style="font-size:0.93rem;font-weight:600;color:#1a3a5c;margin-bottom:3px;">${badge}${i.name}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#1a3a5c;margin-bottom:2px;font-style:italic;">${i.topic}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.82rem;color:#6c757d;">${i.inst} · ${i.period}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");

  document.getElementById("supervision-app").innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:20px;">${filters}</div>
    <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:12px;">Showing <strong>${filtered.length}</strong> of <strong>${STUDENTS.length}</strong> students</div>
    ${items}
  `;
}

function setCat(cat) { activeCat = cat; render(); }
render();
</script>
